Step 2. Consider the meromorphic operator \(Q_{01360012}\) acting on the BMO space. By the meromorphic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|Q_{01360012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01360012\).

Step 3. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|V_{01360013}|^p) \leq C_01360013\) follows from the Holder Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via exponential interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
